_comment: Per-repo configuration for the portfolio CI/CD floor - see CICD_FLOOR.md. The floor's workflows and scripts are byte-identical in every repo; everything that legitimately differs between repos lives here instead, so a repo can change its own settings without regenerating anything and the installer's copies stay verifiably identical. A pull request CAN weaken its own checks by editing this file, which is why changes to it want the same review attention as a change to a workflow - the floor-drift check is what catches divergence that nobody approved.
